name: Reflex Arena

scale.why: assumed Quake's scale (a 56 u player, 0.03214 m/u): Reflex speeds follow Quake / CPM (320 ups), but its hull size isn't published

speed.note: the number is the wiki's; the metre conversion assumes Quake's player size

wallrunMaxSpeed.note: 507 UPS at the assumed Quake scale

doubleJumpWindow.note: a jump within 0.4 s of the last one goes higher (stackable up to a triple jump)

doubleJumpBonus.note: 104 u at the assumed Quake scale

extras: CPM-style air control and strafe jumping
double and triple jumps (consecutive jumps within 0.4 s stack height)
notes: Reflex's physics constants (jump, ground speed and acceleration, air control, bunny acceleration and wish speed, gravity) became server-editable in 0.47.3's Experimental Plus ruleset, but their values weren't found published. Only the run speed and a few movement facts are here.

sources.title: Reflex Wiki: Tutorial for New Players
